title: Grouped var(...) declarations need explicit coverage in the search-format regex/semgrep pair
answers: Why isn't my grouped var declaration of ResourceSearchRequest being flagged?
Does the FIELD_VALUES check catch var ( request resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest ) blocks?
I changed the resource-search-result-format grep/semgrep rule and tests started missing grouped declarations
body: Symptom: a new `var (\n\trequest resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest\n)` grouped declaration that omits or mis-sets ResultFormat is not reliably flagged by the CI check. Root cause: the git-grep pre-filter in .github/workflows/pr-resource-search-result-format.yml that selects files to scan was written against single-line `var x T` declarations and can miss grouped var blocks, and the semgrep pattern `var $REQUEST $PB.ResourceSearchRequest` doesn't by itself cover text split across a `var (...)` block the same way. Fix pattern: the grep regex's standalone-declaration alternative (`^[[:space:]]*[[:alnum:]_]+[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]*ResourceSearchRequest...$`) and the semgrep fixture's `groupedDeclaration` test case exist specifically to keep this case covered — any future change to the git-grep regex or the semgrep rule must add/update a matching fixture case for grouped declarations. Constraints: only matters for *new* code added after the PR base commit (baseline-diff scan); doesn't affect pre-existing grouped declarations.
applies: Edits to the file-selection grep regex in .github/workflows/pr-resource-search-result-format.yml or the semgrep patterns in pkg/storage/unified/semgrep/resource-search-field-values.yaml.
